sourceSentences: [0] Keeping Illaoi's passive tentacles that she spawns frequently off of terrain is one of the more important things to keep her power in lane as low as possible. Think of her passive tentacles as zones of power or control. You ideally don't want to fight her in these areas unless you're comfortable spacing and sidest stepping their slams.

[0] Minimizing their uptime decreases her pressure, so staying on top of killing them at all times is incredibly important. If you have mobility, it also provides a strong opportunity to bait her ECD out.
